verdict.rationale: Docs confirm SIP connectivity: platform engineers can point any SIP client/softphone at a Vapi SIP URI to make/receive calls (vapi-docs-14, vapi-docs-22), which supports self-hosted/carrier SIP trunking use cases. However, the evidence never explicitly documents PBX/carrier trunk configuration options or a number-import workflow for Twilio/Telnyx accounts. missing for 10: explicit documentation of BYO-carrier/PBX trunk setup steps, and evidence of importing existing Twilio/Telnyx phone numbers into Vapi.
